related.title: Airbus A350 複材客機系統工程
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 機體尺度、載荷條件、材料方向及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Aircraft scale, load conditions, material direction and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課的工程脈絡由「共同基準點與重心」推進到「載重位置與結構彎矩」，最後以「重心計算與證據交接」整合。官方資料用於核對原理及證據流程，本教材不把教學假設歸為任何原廠數據或新發現。
courses.summaryEn: The engineering progression moves from Common datum and center of gravity through Load position and structural bending to CG calculation and evidence handoff. Official references support principles and evidence workflows; teaching assumptions are not attributed to manufacturers or presented as new findings.

history.title: 飛機重量與平衡管理
history.text: 本課的工程脈絡由「共同基準點與重心」推進到「載重位置與結構彎矩」，最後以「重心計算與證據交接」整合。官方資料用於核對原理及證據流程，本教材不把教學假設歸為任何原廠數據或新發現。
history.textEn: The engineering progression moves from Common datum and center of gravity through Load position and structural bending to CG calculation and evidence handoff. Official references support principles and evidence workflows; teaching assumptions are not attributed to manufacturers or presented as new findings.

courses.connection: 以「以共同基準點完成重量矩、重心和版本管理」為主線，在非飛行載荷表與桌上平衡模型中依序完成共同基準點與重心、多支點承載假設、載重位置與結構彎矩、構型版本與零件身份、載荷表缺失項目及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
courses.connectionEn: Follow Use one datum to manage weight moments, CG and revisions in a Non-flying load sheet and tabletop balance model, progressing through Common datum and center of gravity, Multiple-support load assumptions, Load position and structural bending, Configuration revision and part identity, Missing load-sheet items, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
